action: Two lanes, different gates. LANE 1 (agent-father, own zone, no gate needed): brief §2 stale-vs-missing guard-logic fix + §1.2-1.4 cross-session marker mechanism, confined to .claude/skills/cron-{cowork,detect-loop,standalone}-team/{SKILL,register}.md + docs/agents/{cowork-team,dev-team,system-auditor}/flow/*.md — implement directly, same posture as every other agent-father-owned brief this session. LANE 2 (PM -> dev-team, needs PO check-in before sprint kickoff per brief §5): brief §1.1, a 1-line WHERE-clause exclusion in apps/mcp-server/src/infrastructure/db/coordinationStore.ts's gcExpiredLocks (adds cron-registration:% to the already-shipped cron:%/dev-team-cron-singleton exclusion pattern) -- flagged for PO awareness because it touches shared always-hot coordination-store infra (every task_claim in the fleet triggers this GC path), not because of any policy tradeoff. LANE 3 (user, zero agent involvement by design per task instruction -- no Cron* tool called by this agent or router): brief §3, exact CronDelete/CronCreate sequence for the 9 already-live job IDs across the user's 3 physical terminals -- ready to run any time, independent of Lane 1/2.
summary: User observed live cross-session cron duplication (4 confirmed duplicate pairs: cowork-tick-preflight, detect-loop self-arm, auditor Tier-1, auditor Tier-2) plus 3 stale-valued live entries (db-integrity Job A/B wrong cadence, auditor Tier-3 stale-and-redundant against an already-correct sibling copy). Root cause: CronCreate/CronList/CronDelete are strictly per-CLI-session, so each of the 3 re-arm skills' Step-1 guard is blind to peer sessions' jobs. Designed a cross-session marker (task_kind reused as sprint-task -- zero schema change, same precedent already used for cron:<flow>:<TICK> fire-election markers -- task_id=cron-registration:<family>, one per skill) gated primarily by session-presence liveness cross-check (fast, <=30min, reuses already-shipped P2 infra) with task_force_release_orphan as the mechanical steal gate once a peer is confirmed dead -- explicitly does not reintroduce the guaranteed-slot-missed regression (project_cowork_guaranteed_slot_needs_live_cli_session) because staleness is detected via session-presence expiry, not via waiting out the marker's own long TTL. Separately fixed the guard's match logic from a single identity+value binary to an explicit 2-phase identity-then-value classify, so a live-but-wrong-valued entry gets CronDelete+CronCreate replaced in place instead of silently duplicated -- this also structurally closes an already self-flagged-but-unfixed gap in cron-cowork-team/SKILL.md's own FIX-COWORK-FIRE-ELECTION-TICK-TOMBSTONE rollout note. Deliberately kept the renewal mechanism scoped to the 3 already-cron-specific dispatch flows rather than touching the universal dispatch-claim/CARD.md Step 0a hot path used by every agent spawn fleet-wide.
